issues: Jest workers are not started with the '--experimental-vm-modules' flag, causing dynamic imports (e.g., in __tests__/acceptance/m5.test.ts) to throw 'TypeError: A dynamic import callback was invoked without --experimental-vm-modules'. Fix by adding the Node option to Jest configuration: in 'jest.config.js' include "nodeOptions": "--experimental-vm-modules" (or set NODE_OPTIONS environment variable) so that all spawned worker processes have the required flag.
feedback: All functional and unit tests pass, but the acceptance test suite fails due to the dynamic import error. Adjust the Jest configuration to propagate the experimental VM modules flag to worker processes. After this change, the acceptance tests should run without errors.
